name: Chatham Lodging Trust (CLDT)
teaser: At $14.18 the shares trade 40.8% above my Base value of $10.07, a downside of 29.0%. The business is improving: second quarter adjusted FFO rose 22% to $0.48 a share and July and August room revenue per available room grew 10% and 8%. But after the money that has to go back into the hotels every year, the owner cash behind the shares is $0.64 a claim, so the price is 22 times it, not the 11 times the headline suggests. To justify $14.18 the hotels would have to earn about 29% more than my already generous first year, or about 42% more than the company guides. Confidence is C and the required margin of safety is 40%, which gives a maximum buy price of $6.04. Reduce for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results are not in this analysis.
llms: Hotel REIT valuation: Reduce at $14.18, Base $10.07, maximum buy price $6.04, Confidence C.
